text:
A car moves along a horizontal road. Its initial kinetic energy is 280kJ. A constant resistive force
of 200N acts on the car. No other horizontal forces act on the car.
What is the kinetic energy of the car after it has travelled a distance of 300m?
A
60kJ
B
80kJ
C
220kJ
D
340kJ
subject: Physics
